","hey junior! solar array tracking is my specialty. keep an eye on battery depth-of-discharge!":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","our experiments, life support and computers all share one power system. can you balance it?":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","one careful choice now keeps the station safe later.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","keep our power stable and the whole station keeps humming.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","dust reduced our solar power again. we need a smart distribution plan.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","mars storms test both planning and patience. let us be ready.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","dust changes everything here. we have to think ahead and conserve power.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,"}};
class MoonshiftVoice {
  constructor() {
    this.supported = typeof window.NativeAudioConstructor === 'function';
    this.enabled = this.supported;
    this.activated = false;
    this.pendingAutoplay = false;
    this.autoAdvance = true;
    this._current = null;
    this._sequence = 0;
    this._ducked = false;
    this.mode = 'recorded-human-voices';
    this.clipCount = 67;
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('moonshift.voice.enabled');
      if(saved !== null) this.enabled = this.supported && saved === 'true';
    } catch(_){}
  }
  activate() {
    if(!this.supported || !this.enabled) return false;
    this.activated = true;
    this.pendingAutoplay = false;
    return true;
  }
  setEnabled(value) {
    this.enabled = this.supported && !!value;
    try { localStorage.setItem('moonshift.voice.enabled',String(this.enabled)); } catch(_){}
    if(!this.enabled) this.stop(); else this.activate();
    return this.enabled;
  }
  toggle(){return this.setEnabled(!this.enabled)}
  _normal(text){
    return String(text||'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/[‘’]/g,"'").replace(/[“”]/g,'"').replace(/[‐‑‒–—]/g,'-').replace(/\u00a0/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
  }
  findClip(speaker,text){
    const lines = window.MoonshiftRecordedClips?.[String(speaker||'').toLowerCase()];
    if(!lines) return null;
    const key=this._normal(text);
    return lines[key] || null;
  }
    _duck(active){ window.Audio?.setVoiceDucked?.(active); this._ducked=active; }
stop(){
    this._sequence++;
    const current=this._current;
    this._current=null;
    if(current){
      current.onplaying=null;current.onended=null;current.onerror=null;current.ontimeupdate=null;
      try{current.pause();current.removeAttribute('src');current.load()}catch(_){}
    }
    if(this._ducked){this._duck(false);this._ducked=false;}
  }
  speak(speaker,text,handlers={}){
    this.stop();
    if(!this.supported || !this.enabled || document.hidden)return false;
    const clip=this.findClip(speaker,text);
    if(!clip){handlers.onError?.('no-human-recording');return false;}
    const seq=++this._sequence;
    let audio;
    try{
      audio=new window.NativeAudioConstructor(clip);
      audio.preload='auto';
      audio.volume = window.Audio?.getEffectiveVoiceVolume?.() ?? 1;
      audio.playbackRate=1;
      this._current=audio;
      const live=()=>this._sequence===seq && this._current===audio;
      audio.onplaying=()=>{if(!live())return;this.activated=true;this.pendingAutoplay=false;this._duck(true);handlers.onStart?.();};
      audio.onended=()=>{if(!live())return;this._current=null;this._duck(false);handlers.onEnd?.();};
      audio.onerror=()=>{if(!live())return;this._current=null;this._duck(false);handlers.onError?.('recording-load-failed');};
      const pending=audio.play();
      if(pending?.catch)pending.catch((err)=>{if(!live())return;this._current=null;this._duck(false);this.pendingAutoplay=true;if(handlers.onBlocked)handlers.onBlocked(err);else handlers.onError?.('recording-playback-blocked');});
      return true;
    }catch(_){this._current=null;this._duck(false);handlers.onError?.('recording-unavailable');return false;}
  }
}


window.Voice=new MoonshiftVoice();
(()=>{
  const unlockVoice=()=>{
    if(!window.Voice)return;
    const wasPending=window.Voice.pendingAutoplay;
    if(window.Voice.enabled && !window.Voice.activated)window.Voice.activate();
    if(wasPending && window.Voice.enabled){
      window.Voice.pendingAutoplay=false;
      if(window.Beyond?.prologueOverlay?.isConnected)window.Beyond.speakPrologue?.();
      else if(window.Story?.isDialogueActive)window.Story.startCurrentDialogueVoice?.();
    }
  };
  ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart','click'].forEach(ev=>document.addEventListener(ev,unlockVoice,{capture:true,passive:true}));
})();
window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>window.Voice.stop());
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)window.Voice.stop();});

</script>

    <script>
/**
 * MOONSHIFT: THE LOST SIGNAL
 * Deterministic NASA Science & ECLSS Simulation Engine
 * Original educational training simulation with fictional mission parameters; not a NASA operational model.
 */

class StationSimulation {
    constructor() {
        this.reset();
    }

    reset() {
        // Time & Progression
        this.missionTimeHours = 0;
        this.dayCycle = 0; // 0 to 1 lunar day phase
        this.sunIllumination = 0.92; // scenario assumption for fictional LUNA-7, not a LOLA-derived measurement
        this.solarStormActive = false;
        this.solarStormProgress = 0; // 0 to 1

        // 1. Power Systems (kW, kWh)
        this.solarCapacityMax = 52.2; // kW, fictional LUNA-7 scenario model, NOT a NASA measurement
        this.solarEventMultiplier = 1; // terrain shading / story-driven availability
        this.solarGeneration = 48.0; // kW currently generated
        this.batteryCapacityMax = 250.0; // kWh total capacity
        this.batteryCharge = 210.0; // kWh current charge (~84%)
        
        // Power loads by subsystem
        this.powerAllocations = {
            lifeSupport: 12.0,    // kW (Priority 1: O2 electrolysis & CO2 blowers)
            greenhouse: 8.0,      // kW (LED PAR grow spectrum)
            communications: 5.0,  // kW (Deep Space Network S-Band & Ka-Band)
            thermalHeaters: 6.0,  // kW (Regolith base thermal control)
            auxiliary: 3.0        // kW (Internal lighting & lab consoles)
        };
        this.totalDemand = 34.0; // kW
        this.netPower = 14.0; // kW (solar - demand)

        // 2. ECLSS Atmospheric Systems (fictional game parameters, not NASA specifications)
        // Cabin Volume: 350 m³, 4 crew members equivalent
        this.cabinPressure = 101.3; // kPa (Standard 1 atm)
        this.oxygenLevel = 20.9; // % (Nominal: 20.8 - 21.2%)
        this.co2Level = 520; // ppm (Nominal: <800 ppm, Safe limit: <1000 ppm)
        this.temperatureC = 21.5; // °C (Nominal: 20 - 23°C)
        this.relativeHumidity = 48; // % (Nominal: 40 - 60%)

        this.scrubberOperational = true;
        this.oxygenGeneratorOperational = true;

        // 3. Water Recovery System (WRS)
        this.potableWaterLitres = 920.0; // L
        this.greywaterLitres = 85.0; // L
        this.recyclingEfficiency = 0.98; // fictional scenario efficiency, not universal NASA standard
        this.waterPurityPercent = 99.4; // %

        // 4. Greenhouse Agriculture (NASA Veggie & APH)
        this.greenhouseCropHealth = 95.0; // %
        this.lightSpectrumRatio = { red660nm: 55, blue450nm: 45 }; // example teaching recipe, not a universal NASA optimum
        this.moistureLevel = 72; // %
        this.gardenWaterLitresPerHour = 2; // fictional educational irrigation plan
        this.harvestProgress = 42; // %

        // 5. Radiation & Space Weather (NASA DONKI / Lunar Environment)
        this.exteriorRadiation = 28.0; // µSv/hr - fictional demonstration reading, not real NASA dosimetry
        this.interiorRadiation = 14.0; // µSv/hr - fictional training scenario only
        this.stormShelterShieldLocked = false; // Emergency regolith storm shutters

        // 6. Communications & Light Delay
        this.earthDistanceKm = 384400; // Average lunar distance
        this.lightSpeedKms = 299792.458;
        this.signalDelaySeconds = (this.earthDistanceKm / this.lightSpeedKms); // ~1.282 seconds
        this.dsnLinkQuality = 88.0; // %
        this.antennaAzimuth = 184.2; // degrees
        this.antennaElevation = 42.6; // degrees
        this.antennaAligned = true;

        // Overall Station Status
        this.alerts = [];
        this.powerShortfall = false;
        this.deliveredPower = { ...this.powerAllocations };
        this.overallHealthScore = 96; // 0 to 100
        this.updateAlerts();
    }

    // Fixed-step simulation tick (called every 1.0 second of simulation time)
    update(dt = 1.0) {
        this.missionTimeHours += (dt / 3600);

        // --- Solar Power Generation ---
        if (this.solarStormActive) {
            // High coronal particle noise & flare scintillation
            this.exteriorRadiation = 3800.0 + Math.sin(this.missionTimeHours * 10) * 800; // µSv/hr
        } else {
            this.exteriorRadiation = 25.0 + Math.sin(this.missionTimeHours) * 4;
        }

        // Calculate solar irradiance
        this.solarGeneration = this.solarCapacityMax * this.sunIllumination * this.solarEventMultiplier;
        
        // Sum total power demand
        this.totalDemand = 
            this.powerAllocations.lifeSupport +
            this.powerAllocations.greenhouse +
            this.powerAllocations.communications +
            this.powerAllocations.thermalHeaters +
            this.powerAllocations.auxiliary;

        this.netPower = this.solarGeneration - this.totalDemand;

        // Simplified habitat thermal balance: heaters draw real electricity from the same bus.
        // Entire curve is fictional training data, not a NASA cabin thermal specification.
        const targetCabinC = 19.7 + (this.powerAllocations.thermalHeaters - 3) * .48;
        this.temperatureC += (targetCabinC - this.temperatureC) * Math.min(1, (dt / 3600) * 1.5);

        // Battery charge / discharge (dt in seconds converted to hours)
        const energyDelta = this.netPower * (dt / 3600);
        this.batteryCharge = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.batteryCapacityMax, this.batteryCharge + energyDelta));
        const batteryPct = (this.batteryCharge / this.batteryCapacityMax) * 100;

        // If the battery is empty and loads exceed sunlight, there is a real shortage.
        // Give the available sunlight first to life support, then communications,
        // then warmth, the greenhouse, and finally auxiliary equipment.
        // Delivered loads are a simplified educational priority schedule, not NASA hardware specs.
        this.powerShortfall = this.batteryCharge <= 0.001 && this.netPower < 0;
        let available = this.powerShortfall ? this.solarGeneration : this.totalDemand;
        this.deliveredPower = {};
        for (const system of ['lifeSupport','communications','thermalHeaters','greenhouse','auxiliary']) {
            const supplied = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.powerAllocations[system],available));
            this.deliveredPower[system] = supplied;
            available -= supplied;
        }
        this.oxygenGeneratorOperational = this.deliveredPower.lifeSupport >= 10;

        // --- ECLSS Atmosphere Simulation ---
        // Crew consumption: ~0.84 kg O2 / day for 4 crew = ~0.035 kg/hr = drops ~0.02% per hour if unreplenished
        const o2ConsumptionRate = 0.000008 * dt; 
        if (this.oxygenGeneratorOperational && this.powerAllocations.lifeSupport >= 10.0) {
            // Electrolysis restores oxygen to target 21.0%
            if (this.oxygenLevel < 21.0) {
                this.oxygenLevel += 0.00002 * dt;
            }
        } else {
            this.oxygenLevel -= o2ConsumptionRate;
        }
        this.oxygenLevel = Math.max(14.0, Math.min(23.0, this.oxygenLevel));

        // CO2 Accumulation: ~1.0 kg/day for 4 crew
        const co2GenerationRate = 0.08 * dt; // ppm per second without scrubber
        if (this.scrubberOperational && this.deliveredPower.lifeSupport >= 8.0) {
            if (this.co2Level > 450) {
                this.co2Level -= 0.12 * dt;
            }
        } else {
            this.co2Level += co2GenerationRate;
        }
        this.co2Level = Math.max(400, Math.min(3000, this.co2Level));

        // --- Simplified Water Loop (all values are authored LUNA-7 scenario parameters) ---
        const hours = dt / 3600;
        const waterNeeded = hours * (0.65 + this.gardenWaterLitresPerHour);
        const waterRecovered = waterNeeded * this.recyclingEfficiency;
        this.potableWaterLitres = Math.max(0, Math.min(1200, this.potableWaterLitres - waterNeeded + waterRecovered));
        this.greywaterLitres = Math.min(1200, this.greywaterLitres + waterNeeded * (1 - this.recyclingEfficiency));

        // --- Greenhouse Plant Health ---
        const optimalLight = this.deliveredPower.greenhouse >= 7.0 && this.gardenWaterLitresPerHour >= 2;
        if (optimalLight && this.waterPurityPercent > 95 && this.potableWaterLitres > 5) {
            this.greenhouseCropHealth = Math.min(100, this.greenhouseCropHealth + 0.005 * dt);
            this.harvestProgress = Math.min(100, this.harvestProgress + 0.01 * dt);
        } else {
            this.greenhouseCropHealth = Math.max(20, this.greenhouseCropHealth - 0.02 * dt);
        }

        // --- Radiation Exposure Inside Station ---
        if (this.solarStormActive) {
            if (this.stormShelterShieldLocked) {
                // High density regolith storm shield absorbs 98% of storm protons
                this.interiorRadiation = 35.0; // demonstrative game value, NOT a radiation forecast
            } else {
                // Exposed observation modules and thin shell areas absorb secondary bremsstrahlung
                this.interiorRadiation = 480.0; // demonstrative game value, NOT a radiation forecast
            }
        } else {
            this.interiorRadiation = 12.0 + (this.exteriorRadiation * 0.1);
        }

        // --- Communications Link Quality ---
        if (this.deliveredPower.communications < 4.0 || !this.antennaAligned) {
            this.dsnLinkQuality = Math.max(0, this.dsnLinkQuality - 0.2 * dt);
        } else if (this.solarStormActive) {
            // Ionospheric / space weather RF attenuation
            this.dsnLinkQuality = Math.max(15, 55 + 10 * Math.sin(this.missionTimeHours));
        } else {
            this.dsnLinkQuality = Math.min(100, this.dsnLinkQuality + 0.3 * dt);
        }

        // Update active alerts list
        this.updateAlerts();
    }

    updateAlerts() {
        this.alerts = [];

        if (this.powerShortfall) {
            this.alerts.push({
                level: 'critical',
                title: 'ELECTRICITY SHORTAGE',
                desc: 'The battery is empty and sunlight cannot power every machine. Reduce loads in the Power Room.'
            });
        }
        if (this.batteryCharge < 50.0) {
            this.alerts.push({
                level: 'warning',
                title: 'LOW BATTERY RESERVE',
                desc: `Battery at ${((this.batteryCharge / this.batteryCapacityMax) * 100).toFixed(0)}%. Rebalance Power Room conduits.`
            });
        }

        if (this.co2Level > 900) {
            this.alerts.push({
                level: 'critical',
                title: 'ECLSS CO2 BUILDUP',
                desc: `Carbon Dioxide at ${this.co2Level.toFixed(0)} ppm (Threshold: 1000 ppm). Service amine scrubber.`
            });
        }

        if (this.oxygenLevel < 19.5) {
            this.alerts.push({
                level: 'critical',
                title: 'OXYGEN PARTIAL PRESSURE LOW',
                desc: `O2 concentration at ${this.oxygenLevel.toFixed(1)}%. Ensure power to water electrolysis.`
            });
        }

        if (this.solarStormActive && !this.stormShelterShieldLocked) {
            this.alerts.push({
                level: 'hazard',
                title: 'SIMULATED SPACE-WEATHER WARNING',
                desc: 'Fictional training event inspired by NASA space weather: prepare the crew shelter.'
            });
        }

        if (this.dsnLinkQuality < 30) {
            this.alerts.push({
                level: 'warning',
                title: 'EARTH DSN SIGNAL LOST',
                desc: 'Communications carrier lost. Realign dish in Communications Room.'
            });
        }

        // Calculate 3 Child-Facing Primary Metrics:
        // POWER (0 - 100%), AIR (0 - 100%), SAFETY (0 - 100%)
        const batteryPct = (this.batteryCharge / this.batteryCapacityMax) * 100;
        this.hudPower = Math.round(batteryPct);

        const o2Score = Math.max(0, 100 - Math.abs(21.0 - this.oxygenLevel) * 20);
        const co2Score = Math.max(0, 100 - Math.max(0, (this.co2Level - 500) / 10));
        this.hudAir = Math.round((o2Score + co2Score) / 2);

        let safetyScore = 100;
        if (this.interiorRadiation > 100) safetyScore -= 50;
        else if (this.interiorRadiation > 40) safetyScore -= 20;
        if (this.cabinPressure < 95) safetyScore -= 30;
        if (this.solarStormActive && !this.stormShelterShieldLocked) safetyScore -= 35;
        this.hudSafety = Math.max(10, Math.round(safetyScore));

        this.overallHealthScore = Math.round((this.hudPower + this.hudAir + this.hudSafety) / 3);
    }

    // Player action: Adjust power routing
    setPowerAllocation(system, kw) {
        if (this.powerAllocations[system] !== undefined) {
            this.powerAllocations[system] = Math.max(0, Math.min(25, kw));
        }
    }
}

// Global simulation singleton
window.Sim = new StationSimulation();

</script>
